entities.name: Carlos José Gutiérrez de los Ríos y Rohan Chabot Fernán-Núñez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos José Gutiérrez de los Ríos y Rohan-Chabot, 6th Count of Fernán Núñez was a Spanish soldier and Diplomat whose military career spanned over two decades. From a noble family, after his military career he served in several diplomatic capacities including Ambassador to Portugal from 1778 to 1788 and Ambassador to France from 1787 to 1791.

entities.summary: Carlos José Gutiérrez de los Ríos y Rohan-Chabot, 6th Count of Fernán Núñez was a Spanish soldier and Diplomat whose military career spanned over two decades. From a noble family, after his military career he served in several diplomatic capacities including Ambassador to Portugal from 1778 to 1788 and Ambassador to France from 1787 to 1791.
